label.description: English label naming the opponent Collective, shown to the player; a fictional identity, never a real esports organization (docs/adr/0005, docs/adr/0007)

disciplineId.description: id from content/disciplines/; the opponent plays this discipline

originId.description: id from content/regions/; the opponent's origin, passed to the core generator

level.description: 1 — basement amateur, 5 — world top; passed to the core generator

reward.description: money paid on settlement, exactly once, for each Contest outcome; draw is a declared amount, not a fallback

win.description: credited on a first-win outcome, on the one-tenth money grid

loss.description: credited on a second-win outcome, on the one-tenth money grid

draw.description: credited on a regulation-draw outcome, on the one-tenth money grid
